generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: An open positive class is implemented with a finite catalog, registry, allowlist, enum, table or known set as a mandatory acceptance prerequisite, so all known fixtures pass while valid unseen members are rejected.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat membership in a finite known set as necessary proof of validity even though the contract requires accepting future or otherwise unenumerated valid members.
trigger_signals: contract says any valid, equivalent, future, other valid, or similar open positive wording
candidate checks catalog, registry, allowlist, enum, table or known set inside acceptance predicate
positive fixtures are all members of the same finite source used by implementation
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: For every open positive class guarded by a finite source, require a valid positive discriminant absent from all implementation finite sources, sibling positives across at least two forms or surfaces, and a nearby negative boundary.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Inspect acceptance predicates for finite-source membership and attack them with a valid unseen member; fail the control when all positive fixtures are already known by the same finite source.
